'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[United Nations]] [[Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator]] [[Thomas Fletcher (diplomat)|Thomas Fletcher]] reports that over 10,000 aid trucks have arrived in the [[Gaza Strip]] since the [[ceasefire]] took effect on January 19. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2589292/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
**[[Italy|Italian]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Italy)|foreign minister]] [[Antonio Tajani]] announces that Italy will stop working with [[UNRWA]] after the mother of a [[Gaza war hostage crisis|freed hostage]] said that her daughter had been held at a UNRWA facility in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/in-meeting-with-saar-top-italian-diplomat-says-rome-will-no-longer-work-with-unrwa/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[President of Malawi|Malawian President]] [[Lazarus Chakwera]] orders [[Malawian Defence Force|Malawian troops]] to withdraw from [[peacekeeping]] operations in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] as the crisis escalates. Three Malawian soldiers have been killed in recent fighting in [[North Kivu]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0m1jmdr4jgo (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Three people are killed in a [[Russia]]n [[guided bomb]] attack that destroyed a residential building in [[Myropillia]], [[Sumy Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], according to [[Ukrainian Prosecutor General|Ukrainian officials]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-strike-ukraines-sumy-region-kills-3-officials-say-2025-02-07/ (Reuters)] 
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[Ukrainian Air Force]] receives the first shipment of [[Dassault Mirage 2000|Mirage 2000]] [[fighter jet]]s from [[France]] and more [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 Fighting Falcon]]s from the [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-receives-french-and-dutch-fighter-jets/a-71530786 (DW)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**Ten [[Niger Armed Forces|Nigerien soldiers]] are killed in an ambush by [[Islamic State – Sahel Province|Islamic State]] fighters near the border with [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://apnews.com/article/niger-ambush-sahel-violence-army-islamic-state-1dcbbf12ac1eafb6af0be5063f673696 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Bering Air Flight 445]]
**A [[Cessna 208B Grand Caravan]] carrying ten people goes missing on a flight from [[Unalakleet, Alaska]], [[United States]], to [[Nome, Alaska|Nome]]. A search and rescue operation is underway. [https://www.alaskasnewssource.com/2025/02/07/report-possible-plane-with-10-onboard-down-near-nome/ (KTUU-TV)]
*Four people are killed after a [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]]-contracted [[Beechcraft Super King Air 300]] [[surveillance aircraft]] crashes in a [[paddy field]] in [[Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur|Ampatuan]], [[Maguindanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-plane-crash-us-military-24ff90663ffec8033361d26fb9ac17db (AP)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-02-07/us-contracted-light-plane-crash-kills-four-in-philippines/104907506 (ABC News Australia)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Moldova–European Union relations]]
**[[2025 Moldovan energy crisis]]
***[[Moldova]] [[Prime Minister of Moldova|Prime Minister]] [[Dorin Recean]] calls for the breakaway state of [[Transnistria]] to take steps to avoid a new gas crisis. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-pm-says-separatist-region-must-take-steps-avoid-new-gas-crisis-2025-02-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Azerbaijan–Russia relations]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] authorities announce that they will close their local [[Rossotrudnichestvo]] (''House of Russia'') branch in [[Baku]]. [https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/4002469.html (Trend)]
*[[United States and the International Criminal Court]], [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[executive order]] imposing [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on [[International Criminal Court]] officials that assist investigations into [[U.S. citizens]] or those of its allies, namely [[Citizen of Israel|Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/trump-impose-sanctions-international-criminal-court-2025-02-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-executive-order-sanctioning-international-criminal-court-rcna191018 (NBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/trump-icc-sanctions-israel-order-01beee050ae84d0d9eae66d00bc8ead9 (AP)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**In an operation led by [[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]], the U.S. formally seizes a [[Government of Venezuela|Venezuelan government]] airplane in the [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/06/politics/marco-rubio-dominican-republic-plane-latam-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Greek presidential election]]
**In the third round of voting, the [[Hellenic Parliament]] fails to elect the new [[President of Greece]]. A fourth and final round is called for February 12. [https://www.tovima.com/uncategorized/tasoulas-falls-short-again-final-presidential-vote-set-for-february-12/ (''To Vima'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]]'s [[Center for Near-Earth Object Studies]] says that the probability of [[asteroid]] {{mpl|2024 YR|4}} impacting [[Earth]] on 22 December 2032 has increased to 2.3%, or a (1-in-43) chance, following further observations of its trajectory. More observations are planned in the coming months to gather data on the asteroid before it moves too far away from Earth-based telescopes to be accurately observed. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2025/feb/06/asteroid-impact-chances (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[FIFA]] suspends the [[Football in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]] and [[Football in Pakistan|Pakistan]] from official international competitions for violations of its statutes, citing third-party interference in the [[Congolese Football Federation]] and the [[Pakistan Football Federation]]'s failure to implement [[Constitution of Pakistan|constitutional]] reforms ensuring fair [[Elections in Pakistan|elections]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/fifa-suspends-congo-republic-pakistan-2025-02-07/ (Reuters)]
